panels.shot: Waterline establishing panel at Kahalu'u Bay, low enough to show clear water over dark lava shapes.
panels.action: Embry and Kai wait outside the lineup instead of cutting across it. Heat, glare, and the public reef break establish that the stolen sick day still has rules.
panels.prompt_fragment: Keep Embry in a navy rashguard and Kai in a black rashguard. Show Kahalu'u Bay as a shared public reef break, not an empty private beach.

panels.shot: Medium action panel on Embry's borrowed white shortboard, hands and rail grip visible.
panels.action: Embry's phone buzzes from the beach bag as sweat and salt mark her face. Her palm skids on sun-softened wax, forcing her to reset her rail grip before the wave reaches the reef line.

references.title: Embry surfing on the Big Island

panels.prompt_fragment: Do not make Embry reckless. Show autonomy through grip, timing, breath, and a physically careful commitment.

panels.shot: Two-character lineup panel with Kai slightly outside and Embry closer to the decision point.
panels.action: Kai reads the local, the channel, the reef, and Embry's paddle cadence. He holds position instead of taking the easy wave, then gives one restrained cue.
panels.dialogue: Kai: If we paddle now, we're cutting across the lineup.

references.title: Kai Akana surfing on the Big Island

panels.prompt_fragment: Kai is competent through restraint. Avoid lecturer, rescuer, or hero framing.

panels.shot: Decisive waterline panel as the clean shoulder stands up over the visible reef boundary.
panels.action: Embry chooses the safe channel and commits only when the lineup opens. The wave, reef, softened wax, and phone obligation converge into one visible decision.
